additional_info.subject: RE: ID0462683-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multiple] CU not reachable CRM:02681001115
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0462683,
opened for two chargers being offline from OCPP Backend side.
Here are my findings:
Charger
MP / R9 170002554
:
The charger went Offline from OCPP Backend side yesterday evening, and came back online this morning (19.11.2025) after a reboot,
I checked in the logs and could not find anything particular, it looks as a random lost of connection. Nothing to do here
Charger
Y2/SD 314015297001
:
I checked the charger remotely and router 2 XF4 has a Failure on the SIM card
I rebooted remotely via SSH first the router and then the Charger, and the router cannot detect the SIM card anymore.
I will forward this ticket to the RC-IT colleagues, so that they can go onsite and verify the status of the router and SIM card.
With kind regards,
